caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a person in a hooded cloak standing on a rectangular base next to a brick-like pedestal with a coin slot on the top. The person is colored in muted tones, mainly greenish-gray with accents of brown, yellow, and red. The figure has a sack or bundle, colored yellow and light red, slung over their back, and their face is visible in profile, showing a long, pointed nose and a beard. The pedestal to the right of the figure is depicted in shades of red and brown, with black lines suggesting brickwork, and has a stepped, layered construction culminating in a rectangular top with a slot. The background is blank and unadorned, emphasizing the two objects as the focus of the composition.
title: Toy Bank: Santa Claus
